<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/gateway/{gateway}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns stored information about the gateway. Credentials are masked: stored passwords, the credentials in any proxy or webhook URL, and the values of custom webhook headers all read back as "******". A masked value is not the stored one - leave the field out of an update rather than writing it back, otherwise the mask replaces the credential.
